stories.headline: NASA’s Voyager 1 to hit new space distance record of one light-day
stories.description: The probe was launched in 1977 but it continues to relay space-related data back to a team of NASA scientists daily.

stories.headline: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand
stories.description: The Great British Bake Off presenter says he has not been in contact with the convicted rapist "for many years".

stories.headline: Why US Democrats are expected to keep Schumer and Jeffries in power
stories.description: The prospect of keeping the Congressional leaders in power is exposing long-running tensions in the party.

stories.headline: Crumpsall murder investigation after man's 'shocking' stabbing
stories.description: Police say a 27-year-old man died after being stabbed in the "shocking and tragic attack" in Crumpsall.

stories.headline: When tech founders leave, what happens to their companies?
stories.description: Nvidia could lose 30 percent of its value following cofounder Jensen Huang’s decision to step down, analysts warns.
